author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: तृष्णा नाम इदं मे भूयादित्याशा । सङ्गो वस्तुष्वासक्तिः । तयोः समुद्भवो यस्मात्तत् । रजोभिमानिनी भूदेवी भूतत्त्वं च रागात्मकं सृष्ट्यादिरञ्जनस्वरूपं विद्धि । तद्द्विविधं रजः। कर्मयोगेन देहिनं मानुषं जीवं बध्नाति ॥ १४.७॥
translation:
Rajas, know thou, to be in the form of Raga or passion and the source of desire and attachment; O Kaunteya, it binds the dweller of the body with the attachment to action. (7)
V. Trishna: the desire or hope in the form ‘May I possess this’,’May this be mine.’ Rajas: the matter and the deity Bhu. In the form of Raga: in the shape of arranging the things created. It: both the intelligent and the non-intelligent. The dweller, &c: the human soul.
